mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, conditions at Fireman's Park are overcast with a temperature of 34 degrees. Under the full moon tonight, the temperature will dip to an overnight low of 32 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

In city news, candidate packets for the 2027 Aldermanic elections are now available at the City Clerk's office, and residents are reminded that property tax bills will be mailed out by December 15, with the first installment due on January 31.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music, yoga, and pizza specials all happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to trivia nights at both The Bogey Factory and Hop Haus Brewing.
In a notable call from November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where a woman was found unresponsive in her vehicle and was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the rich Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is currently open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
